First paragraph of a quiet story with just enough words in it that the extractor considers it an article rather than a navigation page, which requires a certain amount of ordinary prose about ordinary things happening to ordinary people in an ordinary town on an ordinary day.

Second paragraph continues in the same vein, describing the weather, the state of the roads, the opinions of a councillor and the price of bread, none of which is remarkable but all of which is faithfully recorded for posterity by a reporter who was there and took notes.
